messages.author: ruhaandalia
messages.content:
Dear Team,

I am raising this ticket regarding the reduction of my Health Points. I successfully completed 100% of my viBe course within the given deadline, and as per the guidelines, I was expecting a 10% Health Points increase on 12th February. However, instead of an increase, my Health Points decreased by approximately 10%.

I had already mailed the team regarding this issue but have not received a response yet.  Therefore, I am following up through this support ticket.

I have attached screenshots showing my course completion status as evidence.

Kindly review my account activity and let me know the reason for this deduction. If this is a technical error, I request you to please update my Health Points accordingly.

I would appreciate your support in resolving this issue at the earliest, as it directly affects my internship progress.

Thank you.

Regards,
Ruhaan Dalia
Cohort-Euclideans
Internship ID – WIN251046
